reason: I could wire an LLM API to our docs in a weekend, and I do not want a bot giving wrong answers to our customers under our brand. A cute mascot does not fix hallucinations, and it can make a wrong answer look worse. I might try the free plan, but I would not start paying in the first month.
objection: Wrong answers in front of my customers, and an agent clicking around and filling forms on my site that I cannot fully control or audit. I would also rather own this than depend on a third-party widget.
would_change_my_mind: Published accuracy numbers on content like mine, a way to restrict answers to my docs with a hard refuse-when-unsure mode, full conversation logs and approval controls for on-site actions, plus a few G2 reviews from SaaS teams like mine.
